  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          i) In Newton's rings pattern, the fringes are getting closer at the edges as compared to the pattern at the  
  center. Give reason.  
  ii) Prove that the radii of dark fringes in Newton's rings varies as square root of radius of curvature of (5)  
  the lens.  
  
  1B)          A Young's interference experiment is performed with monochromatic light. The separation between the  
  slits is 0.500 mm, and the interference pattern on a screen 3.30 m away shows the first side maximum (3)  
  3.40 mm from the center of the pattern. Determine the wavelength of light.  
  
  1C)          If the intensity of sunlight at the Earth's surface under a fairly clear sky is 1000 W/m2, how much  
  electromagnetic energy per cubic meter is contained in sunlight?                                           (2)  
  
  2A)          Differentiate between induced absorption, spontaneous emission and stimulated emission process with  
  reference to LASERs. Why stimulated emission is essential in LASER?                                 (5)  
  
  2B)          The numerical aperture of an optical fibre is 0.2 when surrounded by air. The refractive index of the  
  cladding is 1.59. Determine the refractive index of its core. Also find the acceptance cone half-angle     (3)  
  when the fibre is in water. Refractive index of water is 1.33.

  wavelength of 625 nm is used.  
  i) What is the work function of the surface?                                                               (3)  
  ii) What is the cutoff frequency for this surface?
